Joined the class with full hopes to continue for a long time but somethings happened over the time of 3 months after I joined so was not able to continue.

Cons-
Lacks communication skills
Lacks management skills

Attitude problem, when expressing concern over the all the issues we face

Thank you!

My previous experiences with yoga had always felt like endless twists, difficult stretches, and pushing the body through discomfort. I honestly expected more of the same. But Vishal Sir completely changed my perspective on what yoga should feel like.

What I like is the attention given to recovery and comfort after every asana.

Vishal Sir's patience deserves a special mention. His calm guidance, constant encouragement, and attention to each student create an environment where you genuinely look forward to coming back.
